arena lair effects. 1d4. once the third stage has been reached, rolling the same effect will continue to yield the third stage.

1: wind
- difficult terrain
- DC 10 dex save. 2d8 bludgeoning and knocked prone
- for every 15 ft. of movement, DC 10 dex save or knocked prone. next turn, unless moved away by some means, DC 10 dex save or fall into the abyss.

2: water
- difficult terrain
- DC 10 strength save or be knocked prone
- DC 10 dex save or fall in the water. next turn, unless moved away by some means, DC 10 strength save. on a failure, sucked into a whirlpool and DC 15 strength save over three turns until sucked in and drowned

3: ~(global warming)~
- walls. DC 10 athletics or acrobatics to climb it
- DC 10 con save or take 5 fire damage
- every 30 ft. of movement, roll a d20. on a 1, take 10d10 fire damage

4: mad mage
- lightning bolt DC 14
- fireball DC 14
- disintegrate DC 14 roll to determine target
